stories.title: Two Teething Toy Sets Recalled — Choking Hazard to Infants

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text: CPSC recalls 2 pull-string teethers from Amazon: CuddleCubs Creations and Aojieni Sili Factory 🚨 Silicone strings can reach the back of a baby's throat. Stop using both immediately. Both recalled July 23. cpsc.gov #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text: To get a refund on the recalled teethers: cut all silicone strings, write "DESTROYED" or "RECALLED" on the body, send a photo to the recall email for a full refund. Details at cpsc.gov/Recalls #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting
